<user_query>
How do I reverse a list in Python?
</user_query>
Use list.reverse() in place, or reversed(lst) for an iterator.

<timestamp>Monday, Jun 18, 2026, 5:22 PM (UTC+0)</timestamp>
<user_query>
And to sort it?
</user_query>
Call lst.sort() to sort in place, or sorted(lst) to get a new list.
